AYAMOD-STAR_OF_DEATH.title: Star of Death
AYAMOD-STAR_OF_DEATH.description: Each time you deal attack damage, apply [blue]{OmenOfDeathPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Death Star[/gold].
AYAMOD-STAR_OF_DEATH.flavor: Look! The Death Star is shining in the sky above you!
AYAMOD-THIRSTY_BLOOD_JADE.title: Bloodthirsty Yin-Yang Orb
AYAMOD-THIRSTY_BLOOD_JADE.description: Upon entering and leaving an Elite combat, heal [blue]{Heal:diff()}[/blue] HP.
AYAMOD-THIRSTY_BLOOD_JADE.flavor: If you stop fighting, death will soon catch up.
AYAMOD-BLACK_GOHEI.title: Jet-Black Gohei
AYAMOD-BLACK_GOHEI.description: Whenever an enemy dies, gain [blue]{IntangiblePower:diff()}[/blue] Intangible.
AYAMOD-BLACK_GOHEI.flavor: A weapon that spreads calamity, not a ritual tool for purification, for its wielder is no shrine maiden.
AYAMOD-BLOODS_BANE.title: Blood's Bane
AYAMOD-BLOODS_BANE.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{Energy:energyIcons()}[/blue]. Upon pickup, add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Huo[/gold] to your deck.
AYAMOD-BLOODS_BANE.flavor: A cursed seal on the demon's body, emitting an ominous aura.
AYAMOD-STAR_OF_DOOM.title: Star of Doom
AYAMOD-STAR_OF_DOOM.description: Each time you deal attack damage, apply [blue]{OmenOfDeathPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Death Star[/gold]. At the start of combat, apply [blue]{CombatStartPowerCount:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Death Star[/gold] to ALL enemies. When an enemy dies, transfer its [gold]Death Star[/gold] stacks to a random enemy.
AYAMOD-STAR_OF_DOOM.flavor: You can't just die without a reason. That's why you kept fighting, striving to live, and ultimately became a demon beyond humanity.
AYAMOD-FOUL_BLOOD.title: Foul Blood
AYAMOD-FOUL_BLOOD.description: At the start of Elite combats, gain [blue]{StrengthPower:diff()}[/blue] Strength and [blue]{DexterityPower:diff()}[/blue] Dexterity. The effect decreases by [blue]{Decrease:inverseDiff()}[/blue] after each Elite combat, down to a minimum of [blue]{Minimum:diff()}[/blue].
AYAMOD-FOUL_BLOOD.flavor: These beasts must be driven out, every last one of them.
AYAMOD-HIDDEN_DOOM.title: Hidden Doom
AYAMOD-HIDDEN_DOOM.description: Combats encountered in ? rooms become Elite combats. All card rewards from Elite combats are Upgraded.
AYAMOD-DIRTCHEAP_TEA.title: Actually Cheap Tea
AYAMOD-DIRTCHEAP_TEA.description: At the start of each combat, obtain a [gold]Actually Cheap Tea[/gold] potion.
AYAMOD-DIRTCHEAP_TEA.flavor: In this regard, she is exactly like that shrine maiden.
AYAMOD-DIRTCHEAP_CIGARETTE.title: Actually Cheap Cigarette
AYAMOD-DIRTCHEAP_CIGARETTE.description: Every time you apply {Interval:inverseDiff()} [gold]Death Star[/gold], gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
AYAMOD-DIRTCHEAP_CIGARETTE.flavor: It's okay to smoke because she's a bad kid. No problem at all.
AYAMOD-BREAST_BIND.title: Chest Binding
AYAMOD-BREAST_BIND.description: At the start of Elite or Boss combats, gain {BufferPower:diff()} [gold]Buffer[/gold].
